A moon housed by a friendly religious group.
They care for nature. It is their purpose. It is their believe.
But don't be mislead by the beauty of this moon.

> Moon Map

> Moon Info

POPULATION: Few

CONDITIONS: Half days, warm, fields of invasive flower species.

FAUNA: Dominated by Earth Leviathans.

> Environment

Unfinished Section

This section seems unfinished. If you're a wiki editor, please help with completing this section.

Faith is covered with flora. The landscape is also littered with holes due to the Earth Leviathan activity. Half-days occur on Faith, meaning it gets very dark very quickly.

> Weather

Faith can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Flooded, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, or Hurricane weather by default.

> Moon Exclusive Content

Inside & Outside (Day & Night) Ambience

On Faith you can hear three ambiences: Inside ambience (that plays inside facility), day ambience (that plays during the day) and night ambience (Which plays during night).

Day Outside Ambience

Night Outside Ambience

Inside Ambience

Secret Passage

Faith's exterior has various interactable levers on stone shrines. Pulling the lever will cause the light to change color and a sound effect to be heard. The easiest way to reach any of them is to follow the dirt pathway and there are six in total. Once all six levers have been pulled, a hidden area will open in a giant rock that is behind and to the far right of the ship (near the Cosmocos shrine). Inside will be the scrap "My task 5" as well as an interactable mysterious object.

If players interact with this object, the inside of the rock will change and an Assimilated Growth will immediately spawn in the interior when landing on Faith in the future. This persists until the player is fired unless the Brooding seeds from Berunah are placed on the other altars found on the exteriors of Etern, Filitrios, Fission-C, Gloom, and Utril. Once every seed has been placed, the object will move onto the altar on its own if players did not move it already and all these changes become permanent on that save file.

> Progression

Unlocked By

Log "My task 4" that has at least one guaranteed spawn as scrap within the interior of Core.

Unlocks

Berunah: Log "My task 5" found in the Secret Passage on the exterior.
Hyve: A breakable hive can spawn near the Faith shrine and big rock south of the ship on the exterior, spawning the Hyve videotape when broken.

> Lore

Drawings From Faith

All drawings can be found on moon's exterior in small chapels. Each drawing shows one of 6 moons (Atlantica, Cosmocos, Faith, Etern, Junic, Polarus) as some kind of God that humans pray to. Also every single one has it's own description.

Atlantica

Image & Text ⁠
Atlantica
The defender of sorrowed seas

Her tears flow with the waves
Her waves flow through the citadels
Her sadness tasting until the end of time

Unable to protect her people and their homes
Watching them fall time and time again
Powerless to prevent

This presence signifies grief, one to be comforted

Cosmocos

Image & Text ⁠
Cosmocos
Shaper of celestial beauty

From glittering crystals to bioluminescent growth
A creature with hands that shape the stars
One who creates with uniquentess unfound

A mind full of wonder
He ponders in silence, dreams and imagines

This presence signifies creativity, one to be inspired by

Faith

Image & Text ⁠
Faith
Keeper of peace

There where the grass grows the tallest
The flowers spread the widest

She guides the restless toward forgiveness
Predators to pause and grey to trust.
Wherever she roams, the world breathes of ease

The presence signifies union, a lesson to remember

Etern

Image & Text ⁠
Etern
Walker of wild sands

Between the hills of sand he walks
Observing the horizon
Guarding his path from those who dare intrude

A quiet soul who kept a promise
None others shall walk his way to home

The presence signifies responsibility one to be mindful

Junic

Image & Text ⁠
Junic
Beast of the jungles

The woods are dark
And their intents darker
There roams a beast a demon a creature of ill will

He watches the people closely
Compells them to do wretched things

The presence signifies evil, one to be fearful of

Polarus

Image & Text ⁠
Polarus
Survivor of the cold

The winds shriek with Frost and snow
Lakes of ice, death lays beneath
Conditions too harsh for one to stay

But an old man knows when to wait
He knows not to meddle with nature
But to embrance its ways

The presence signifies wisdom, one to look up to

Presence Notes

Presence 1

Image & Text ⁠
Many years ago in a time long passed.
A young man stood between the flowers in a ray of moonlight.
Observing the stars, taking in the beauty that is the universe.
He did this every night. And every time it was breathtaking.
But on one fateful night it was different.
He saw a bright light in the sky.
A comet?, A creature? no, something more.
He described it as a soul or a presence..
And it spoke.
There between the flowers he listened to this voice from deep space.
It sounded powerful, but vague. A message he couldn't understand.
Yet he was inspired. He had to hear this again.
He had to tell everyone he knew.
This was something special.

Presence 2

Image & Text ⁠
And every night he went back to that spot.
Hoping to see that light again.
But he didn't. For days he waited, hoping.
And it wasn't until the seventh day when he heard it again. He saw it in the sky.
He was certain it was real.
The message was equally vague. Now he was determined.

He explained it to his friends. It took a lot of convincing to get them to join him for one night.

And that night it was there. They all saw it. Moving across the sky.
Yet only he was able to hear it.
But they believed him.
They weren't sure what to make of it.
They all sat there, pondering, wondering.
What or... who is this?

Presence 3

Image & Text ⁠
They brought this newfound knowledge to the village. They told everyone.
While of course there were a lot of sceptics, there were few who had seen this light before when they were young. It had never spoken to them however.
Maybe it wasn't a creature. Or something akin to that. Maybe it was the essence of their moon. Like a spirit, a presence as they described it.
It only made sense...
And so they wished to see it again. To hopefully hear it speak, again.
They built shrines to please this presence.
And even those of others.
They started giving them names, bodies, appearences, identities.
They would bring gifts to please them.
They would care for nature. The well being of their moon. Hoping to hear it again.

... They never did, but they kept trying.

My Task 5

Image & Text ⁠
I have made it to faith but my health has rapidly declined.
I can barely walk.

It's there, I feel it sitting in my chest...
Growing...
This tumor.
I escaped the war.. I SURVIVED
And this is how the universe rewards me?
Life is suffering.
Always has been, from the moment I was created.
One month after being born I was already on the battlefield. Posessing memories of someone I'm not.
They didn't even give me a name.
I was a number. A duplicate of someone else.
...
My body is crumbling, I should get going.
And when I'm done.
All my problems will go away.


My salvation lies on Berunah.
